static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.family_status: Living with parents and younger brother
static_traits.social_status: Difficulty making friends in the new environment; though supported by parents and younger brother, hard to express loneliness and insecurity to family
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; without previous psychotherapy experience; similar psychological problems had not appeared before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, able to self-reflect and identify automatic thoughts; positive attitude, willing to try new methods; presenting anxiety on social topics but able to discuss rationally

basic_info.main_problem: I believe that even if I make friends in fall soccer, they are only friends with me because we have to play together, and this belief makes me feel lonely and insecure.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because my loneliness and insecurity persist and affect my physical and mental health.
growth_experiences: The client recently began experiencing insecurity and loneliness after moving to a new place, and making friends has become difficult; at the old home there were stable friendships, feeling accepted and comfortable from long-term contact, shared interests, and same school and community; after the move, not many friends made yet, feeling anxiety and uncertainty about the upcoming summer camp and fall soccer.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being liked
My true self will not be truly accepted

special_situations.event: Thinking that autumn soccer training and matches will begin
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not actively choose to be friends with me, then it is not true friendship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing the risk of being rejected by participating less or not going, and presetting that they are just teammates
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are only friends with me because they want to play soccer together

special_situations.event: Considering interacting with new classmates at summer camp
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not interesting enough, I will not be liked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to maintain positive expectations, but worries excessively and self-evaluates before actual interactions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may not be interesting enough, others will not like the real me

special_situations.event: Long time after moving to the new place without making many friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot make friends now, it means I am not liked, and it will be hard to change in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pinning hopes on future activities (summer camp, soccer) rather than present actual action
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have never made friends since I got here, which means I am not liked

special_situations.event: Recalls friendships at the old residence and compares with the current environment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only friendships like in the past, with long time together and completely identical interests, count as real
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly comparing the present with the past, ignoring possible positive signals now
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Current friends will not truly like me the way past ones did

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be genuinely liked and accepted, and to have lasting and sincere friendships
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being rejected or being treated superficially and instrumentally, worried the real me is not liked
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being rejected and maintaining safety by keeping some distance or avoiding socializing

object_relations.self_representation: Not interesting enough, an easily-rejected newcomer
object_relations.object_representation: Others are superficially accepting but insincere companions, treating me only as a teammate

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing new social scenes (such as summer camp or football training) or when thinking about how to make friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will not like the real me, they only accept me because the activity requires it (transference: projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Hesitant tone, cautious wording, often using hypothetical expressions like 'maybe, perhaps'; when asked about specific plans, tending to emphasize worry about others' views and mildly avoiding deep details.

manifestations: After moving to a new environment, finds it hard to make friends and worries about the authenticity of friendships
Feeling insecure and anxious when thinking about socializing and making friends
outcomes: Declining interest in daily activities like painting and reading

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Excessive self-evaluation before socializing (such as 'I may not be interesting enough')
Overly concerned about whether others truly like me, cautiously initiating interactions

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Knowing family is available to talk but still finding it hard to express loneliness and insecurity, keeping the discomfort bottled up inside
Reducing outward help-seeking when anxious, turning energy toward self-repression

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Predicts teammates are only friends because they have to play together
Guessing that others are unwilling to truly engage with oneself

exception_events.target_problem: After moving, facing a new environment and needing to make new friends, the client usually feels anxiety and insecurity, with avoidance or reduced-socializing tendencies, making it hard to build relationships.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the school and community of the old residence, the client once naturally built friendships through shared interests and long-term association, frequently doing activities together, experiencing acceptance and comfort.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different situations and support -- same school and community with classmates, shared interests and a familiar environment; long-term contact brings trust and safety, making interaction smoother.

positive_force: Has past experience and resources of successful friendships (shared interests, long-term contact)
Positive attitude; willing to try reality testing and small-step actions
Academic performance stable; has basic life and study routines
Has potential support from parents and younger brother
Able to recognize and challenge automatic thoughts
negative_force: Core anxiety of fearing not being liked
Significant cognitive distortions (catastrophizing, mind-reading, predicting the future, overgeneralization, all-or-nothing thinking, mental filtering, negating the positive)
Avoidance or reduced participation in social settings
Difficulty expressing loneliness and insecurity to family
Tends to compare current socializing with past relationships and sink into disappointment

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and anxiety when making friends in the new environment
antecedent: Thinking about needing to make new friends
Approaching or joining social activities such as summer camp and autumn football
Moved to a new environment, peer relationships not yet established
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying the real self is not liked (core anxiety), accompanied by cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind-reading, predicting the future, overgeneralization, and all-or-nothing.
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible rejection and discomfort to temporarily relieve anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty building new friendships, worsened loneliness and insecurity; decreased interest in drawing and reading
